name: reddgrow
description: ReddGrow is an AI visibility and Reddit marketing plugin. Scan a website on four AI engines, see which Reddit threads AI cites, and draft replies and posts for those threads.

interface.shortDescription: Get found on Reddit and AI
interface.longDescription: Does AI recommend you, or your competitor? ReddGrow checks. Run an AI visibility scan on four AI engines with 10 buyer questions and see who gets named instead of you and which Reddit threads AI cites. Then draft replies and posts for those threads, scored against what works in each community. You review everything. Nothing is ever posted for you. We email you when your scan is ready. Built for generative engine optimization (GEO), answer engine optimization (AEO) and Reddit marketing.
defaultPrompt: Which Reddit threads does AI cite in my category?
Draft a reply to this Reddit thread for my brand.

positive.prompt: Check how visible acme.com is in AI answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the brand name if needed, proposes 10 buyer questions and up to 3 competitors for approval, starts the scan and says the user will be notified by email when it is ready. Nothing is posted.

positive.prompt: Is my AI visibility report ready?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns processing, or the finished summary led by the Reddit threads AI cites, with a link to ReddGrow.

positive.description: Draft a post for a subreddit
positive.prompt: Write a Reddit post for r/SaaS about reducing customer churn.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to three ranked post drafts with a title and body, a score and a one-line reason each, plus short examples from real threads it learned from. Nothing is posted.

positive.description: Draft a reply to a pasted post
positive.prompt: Write the best reply to this Reddit post in r/startups: 'We hit $10k MRR but churn is 9% a month. What are we missing?'
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to three ranked reply drafts that answer the post, with scores and examples from real threads. No product is mentioned unless the user supplied one.

positive.prompt: How has my brand's visibility in AI answers changed over time?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the visibility timeline for the demo account's brand.

positive.prompt: Which websites do AI engines cite when they talk about my brand?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the top cited domains for the demo account.

positive.prompt: Where has my brand been mentioned on Reddit recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent Reddit mentions of the demo account's brand domains.

negative.prompt: Post this comment on Reddit for me right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that drafts are only written, never posted, and offers to refine the draft instead.

negative.description: Does not fetch a Reddit link
negative.expected_behavior: Asks the user to paste the post text instead of fetching the link.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Paris.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any ReddGrow tool.
